long_biography.plain_text:
Défago entered elder care in 1983 by renting additional rooms in the apartment building where he lived. Two years later he acquired a run-down retirement home and began expanding SENIOcare. Over twenty-five years, the company grew to more than two dozen homes and over 1,000 employees. It became Switzerland’s largest private residential and nursing-home group before he sold it.

Casa Solaris opened its first community in 2015, bringing Défago back to the sector. The model treats older residents as customers rather than institutional subjects. It pairs private accommodation with hospitality, dining, support and nursing services selected à la carte. Défago also led senesuisse, the association for independent Swiss elder-care providers, for nearly seventeen years, helping represent the interests of privately operated care homes.
